segments:
You don't need another podcast
about being a better man.
The emperor of Rome wrote himself this:

“No longer talk at all about
the kind of man a good man
ought to be, but be such.”

Close the tab.
Do one hard right thing today.
Send this to a brother who needs the push.

Real men don't cry?
The Stoics disagree.
Seneca, to a friend in grief:

“We may weep,
but we must not wail.”

Feel it fully.
Just don't let it drive.
Save this for the day you need it.
